best_idea: A finisher's victim is hidden by a counted effect for a timed duration and an end burst plays exactly once on detach, with the timing and loop count as data.
decision_why: The data shape (timed end, loop count, end burst, counted hide) is worth keeping for finisher staging, but the donor's timers are client wall-clock with a dispatcher and Lua callbacks; Frankendom keeps the effect as client-only, lets the server decide when a kill is final, and must not wait on effect timers.
acceptance: When a finisher lands the defeated creature disappears for 1.5 s and a burst plays once; a second finisher started on the same creature during that time keeps it hidden until the second one ends; a test asserts the end hook fires exactly once even when two frames see the end.
